field_identity_rule: Analytical outputs use the existing STIMES.ITEM namespace as their canonical field identity. No second master-field identifier is created.
definition: Proteccion juridica vigente, valida y efectivamente aplicable al taxon en La Rioja, preservando por separado evidencia normativa original, normalizacion, seleccion de la proteccion mas restrictiva, score analitico y confiabilidad.

provider.existing_scale: 0-100 when positive applicable legal protection is evidenced; null/UNKNOWN otherwise
provider.existing_aggregation: MAX current applicable evaluable legal record with jurisdiction weights
provider.rule: Existing 05 evidence and native score are preserved. STIMES adds a versioned effective-protection selection because territorial applicability is an eligibility gate rather than a score penalty.

stimes_selection.territorial_rule: A concrete autonomous jurisdiction outside La Rioja is EXTERNAL_AUTONOMOUS_REFERENCE even if upstream metadata labels the record national. EU and international scopes are not autonomous jurisdictions and require explicit legal_applicability_verified=true.
stimes_selection.currentness_rule: Repealed, superseded, modified-away or source-marked-not-current evidence cannot produce the current score; it remains immutable historical evidence.
stimes_selection.conflict_rule: A material unresolved conflict in current applicable legal evidence sets state=CONFLICT and canonical score_100=null; no precautionary maximum is silently promoted to current fact.
stimes_selection.tie_rule: If several current valid applicable records have the same highest effective score, preserve all as co-effective evidence and use a deterministic short display reference.

semantic_states.PROTECTED: A current valid applicable protection record is selected
semantic_states.SIN_PROTECCION: A complete valid search across the configured authorized source set found no current valid applicable protection for a sufficiently resolved taxon and no unresolved potentially protective legal record remains
semantic_states.NO_COMPROBADO: The complete legal check required by the item has not been completed
semantic_states.SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED: One or more required sources could not be acquired
semantic_states.TAXON_UNRESOLVED: Taxonomic identity is insufficiently resolved for a legal assertion
semantic_states.UNKNOWN: Current protection cannot be determined from the acquired evidence
semantic_states.CONFLICT: Currentness, applicability, taxonomy, category mapping or legal relationship remains materially contradictory after deterministic rules

missingness.rule: Provisional zero is permitted only as a downstream computational contribution; it never changes the semantic protection state and never becomes evidence of no protection.

source_priority.caution: Consolidated informational text does not replace the official publication for legal certainty.

verified_structures: Registro Riojano de Especies Silvestres en Regimen de Proteccion Especial
Listado de Especies Silvestres en Regimen de Proteccion Especial

verified_current_legal_framework.verified_effect: Article 13 requires strict protection for Annex IV(b) plants; taxon annex membership and territorial implementation are required before scoring.
Direct EU wildlife-trade controls use Annexes A-D; literal annex and current membership must be verified before scoring.

context_only_legal_sources.rule: Does not by itself produce effective PROTECCION score.
Does not by itself produce effective PROTECCION score.
Reference/information-format presence does not by itself produce effective PROTECCION score.

category_equivalence.rule: Literal category is immutable. Source-model score and effective STIMES score are separate derived values tied to the table version.
category_equivalence.change_policy: New table version + full recalculation; never rewrite original evidence.

reliability.requested_formula: sum(weights of checked components) / sum(total component weights) * 100
reliability.rule: The prompt defines the formula but not component weights or category thresholds, and AMENAZA has no canonical values to inherit. STIMES therefore stores the seven checked-component booleans and counts but does not fabricate a percentage or display class.

dependencies.rule: No URGENCIA or PRIORIDAD formula is implemented in this PROTECCION execution.

storage_mapping.rule: PROTECCION is versioned analytical enrichment/evidence attached to the taxon resource, not a mutable accession/population field.

excel_view.territorial_columns_rule: Display source-original current categories, never replace literal legal category with JBLR score.
excel_view.effective_norm_rule: Short reference to the current valid applicable most-restrictive selected norm; complete co-effective and alternative records remain internal.
excel_view.evidence_rule: One short auditable reference to effective evidence; full chain remains in STIMES.

known_provider_defects_or_gaps.finding: Some EIDOS-derived records from other autonomous communities can carry generic/national upstream labels.
known_provider_defects_or_gaps.stimes_rule: Explicit non-La-Rioja autonomous territory overrides generic upstream scope for applicability.

known_provider_defects_or_gaps.finding: Existing evidence contains at least one CITES Appendix II literal normalized to CITES_A_OR_APPENDIX_I.
known_provider_defects_or_gaps.stimes_rule: Literal guard blocks effective scoring until the source category is reconciled.
